title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming parity across python/typescript/go + ergonomics and version bumps
author: Claire Huang
description: Motivation: bring feature and behavior parity across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs for auth token refresh, retry/backoff semantics, and streaming ergonomics. This PR consolidates shared semantics, fixes inconsistent edge cases observed in production (stale auth tokens during long-lived streams, retry hysteresis on 429 vs 5xx, and inconsistent cancelation APIs), and bumps patch versions for each SDK. Changes include: unified auth plumbing (central refresh + scoped token cache), shared retry policy implementation (exponential backoff with jitter, separate buckets for rate-limit vs transient errors), streaming API ergonomics (cancellable iterator/async-iterator patterns and consistent event types), small API surface tweaks for ergonomics (context managers in Python, abort controllers in TS, context.Context usage in Go), and patch version bumps to publish parity releases. Related Linear tickets: ENG-1573, ENG-1601. Checklist: [x] implement unified auth refresh across SDKs [x] normalize retry semantics and config knobs [x] stabilize streaming type/event surface [x] update docs and examples [x] add unit + integration tests [x] CI green and packages version-bumped. Notes: aimed to be non-breaking for existing customers; where behavior changed in subtle ways we added deprecation docs and feature flags to opt into stricter retry semantics.
commits: fix(sdk-auth): centralize token refresh and scoped cache (python/ts/go)
feat(retries): add unified backoff policy and separate rate-limit bucket
refactor(streaming): standardize streaming events and add cancellable iterators
chore(sdk): ergonomics helpers (Python context manager, TS AbortController glue, Go context helper)
test: add cross-sdk integration tests for long-lived streams and retry scenarios
chore(release): bump python->0.12.4, ts->1.9.1, go->0.7.3 and update changelogs
review_comments: Ben Patel: Nice consolidation. Two asks: 1) can we expose a smaller RetryConfig struct for users who only want to tweak maxAttempts and baseDelay? 2) please add a note in the python changelog about the new context manager pattern.
Claire Huang (author): Addressed both points. Added RetryConfig alias in each SDK and a short example in python CHANGELOG. PTAL.

Diego Ramos: Found an edge case where streaming cancelation could race with token refresh; suggested moving token refresh to preemptive refresh when TTL < 30s. Added a unit test failing before the change and passing after.
Aisha Gomez: CI flake observed in TS integration test (race on AbortController). I added a small backoff and made AbortController usage idempotent. Verified on CI rerun.
Ben Patel: Approve after changes. Diego: Approve. Aisha: Approve.
release_notes: Patches: Python 0.12.4, TypeScript 1.9.1, Go 0.7.3. Fixes: unified auth token refresh across SDKs (reduces stale-token stream failures), consistent retry semantics (separate handling for 429 vs 5xx), streaming ergonomics improved (cancellable iterators/abort controllers/context support). Non-breaking with opt-in stricter retry semantics. See docs/sdk-auth.md and docs/sdk-retries.md for migration guidance.
notes: CI initially had a flaky TS integration test for AbortController; root cause was a missed idempotency path in the glue code. Fixed and re-ran. All SDK package publishes staged after merge.
changelog_snippet: Unify auth/retries/streaming parity across SDKs; ergonomics improvements and patch bumps (python 0.12.4, ts 1.9.1, go 0.7.3).
